contract.title: Microwave Shakshuka Eggs
steps: Season tomato sauce with smoked paprika

recipe.title: Microwave Shakshuka Eggs

workflowSections.title: Warm the smoky sauce
workflowSections.objective: Season and bubble the tomato base in one skillet.

steps.instruction: Pour the tomato sauce into a covered skillet and stir in the smoked paprika. Set over medium heat and warm until the sauce is visibly bubbling across the surface, 4 minutes.

workflowSections.title: Cook the eggs
workflowSections.objective: Set the whites while keeping the yolks jammy.

steps.instruction: Make 4 shallow wells in the bubbling sauce and crack 1 egg into each well. Cover the skillet and cook over medium-low heat until the whites are opaque and set at the edges while the yolks still jiggle when the skillet is gently nudged, 5 minutes.

Scatter the feta around the eggs, cover again, and cook until the feta edges are hot and lightly bubbling and the egg whites are fully set, 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and rest until the yolks thicken slightly but remain jammy, 1 minute.

workflowSections.title: Serve
workflowSections.objective: Finish with warm flatbread for scooping.

steps.instruction: Warm the flatbread in a dry skillet over medium heat until flexible and lightly toasted in spots, 1 minute per side. Serve immediately with the eggs and smoky sauce, keeping the yolks intact for dipping.

recipe.notes: For the best jammy yolks, stop cooking as soon as the whites are opaque and gently set; carryover heat will finish them. Total stovetop time is 14 minutes.
